title: Shared building blocks
description: Formats every other schema reuses. Times are UTC ISO 8601, languages ISO 639-1, countries ISO 3166-1, currencies ISO 4217, phones E.164, money in whole units of the agency's currency.

timestamp.description: UTC only, ending in Z. Example: 2026-12-08T21:04:00Z

local_time.description: Agency local time with no zone, for what the AI says out loud. Example: 2026-12-09T09:30

language.description: ISO 639-1. Every language the text channels can use. Which ones an agency offers is set in its own settings.

voice_language.description: Languages the phone receptionist can speak. no, da and pl are text only. Each agency switches on its own subset in phone.voice_languages.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. Add a country here before onboarding an agency there, because country drives legal rules (recording notices, data region).

currency.description: ISO 4217. Each agency works in one currency. The AI never converts between currencies.

timezone.description: IANA time zone of the agency's office.

data_region.description: Where the agency's personal data is stored. EU agencies use eu. Gulf agencies use the region their lawyer confirms (open question: UAE and Saudi data protection rules).

money.description: Whole units of the agency's currency, no cents. Example: 1200000 means 1.2 million EUR for a Spanish agency, or 1.2 million AED for a Dubai agency.

listing_ref.description: The agency's own reference. Example: CTH-1234

handoff_topic.description: Topics the AI never advises on. visa_residency covers residency-by-investment questions (for example the UAE Golden Visa). investment_returns covers rental yields, ROI and capital growth.
